verdict.rationale: Workable publishes a public REST API reference with scoped, token-authenticated read and write endpoints for jobs, candidates, ratings, members, departments, offers, requisitions and events. Probes confirm the docs are live and machine-readable via llms.txt and markdown pages. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
